message: オフェンス

name: Melilot
message: 「Splendid work.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huff, huff, huff... Is it just my imagination? After firing off that spell just now, I felt something weird.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is a good sign.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, let us take an extended break. Please recover your stamina while reflecting on that sensation.」

name: Melilot
message: 「We will resume training in the evening.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm saved~」
Saturday after school. The instant a break was called, all the strength drained out of my body. Exhaustion washed over me all at once.
I want to just lie down right here, though if I do, I doubt I'd ever be able to get back up.
Rather than just waiting around, I want to make good use of the time remaining until Re-Crea and the Holy Night Festival.
With that in mind, I asked Melilot-san for early morning practice.
Even Shio-chan trains every morning. I got all fired up thinking I'd do my best too, and that part was fine, except--

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san, I know I'm the one who brought this up, but could you please go a little easier on me?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I refuse.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So blunt...」
Melilot-san's training is merciless regardless of whether it's day or night. Early this morning was no different. Morning classes ended, and the long afternoon began--
Student Council activities are completely suspended again today. I was planning to spend the whole afternoon on my Demon Lord training to make up for it, but I was naive.

name: Synn
message: 「I was completely exhausted from training this morning, so I ended up sleeping through most of class.」

name: Synn
message: 「...At this rate, I'm going to fall behind on my studies.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if you lose your scholarship status and are expelled, I can put in a good word for you if you do not mind working as an apprentice librarian?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Alternatively, there is also the path of apprenticing as a butler for the Kujou family.」

name: Synn
message: 「Me, taking care of Ria-senpai and Helena-san's personal needs...?」

name: Synn
message: 「...No, I value my life, so I'll pass.」

name: Melilot
message: 「A wise decision.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, you were thinking about pervy stuff again, weren't you!?」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa?」
When did she come over here? Misa tossed a sports towel right at me.
A clean white towel that smells like sunshine. There's a Blackuma applique sewn onto the corner.

name: Synn
message: 「What are you doing here?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I didn't come here to see you. It's just a coincidence! I was only passing by on my way to return a book to the library!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I see. That's why you're in casual clothes.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, Miss Cristelis, there is currently no record of any book being loaned out to you from this library?」

name: Misa
message: 「Here, wipe your sweat off properly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. The Holy Night Festival is coming up soon, and if I leave sweat on me at this time of year, I'll catch a cold.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I-I-It's not like I'm worried about your health or anything!」
I gaze at Misa.
Misa averts her eyes from me, but soon our gazes meet again. What is it? Something feels off.

name: Synn
message: 「You're the usual Misa, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude, nothing has changed about me!」

name: Misa
message: 「Rather, it's you who changed into a drenched mess, Sakura-kun. A Student Council President like that is just unsightly.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to wipe it off, so just wait a second...」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, make sure you wipe behind your ears properly too!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「...You appear to be sweating more than during your usual training. That must mean you are just that exhausted.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Considering efficiency, rather than training in the afternoon with lingering fatigue, you should dedicate yourself to honing your skills at full strength starting in the evening.」

name: Melilot
message: 「We held morning practice today as a trial, but we will keep it to today only.」

name: Synn
message: 「Understood.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Although, training itself may soon become unnecessary...」

name: Synn
message: 「T-Then, does that mean I've become a full-fledged Demon Lord!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, not in the slightest.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let us be extra thorough just to be safe. Please come here this evening as well. I will hold nothing back as I train you, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, thank you in advance for your instruction.」

name: Misa
message: 「This evening 'too'? You just said 'too,' didn't you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Do you always train in front of the library, Sakura-kun? Even though I've never seen anything like that--」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, that's why something felt off!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, how did you get inside the barrier?」

name: Misa
message: 「Barrier...? I just walked over here normally, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Right before we took a break, the barrier was shattered by Sakura-kun's strike.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... that weird sensation just now was...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed. You instinctively sensed that the inner world and the outer world had reconnected.」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's what it was. I've gotten at least a little stronger, haven't I.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Make sure you never grow overconfident.」

name: Melilot
message: 「A barrier is just like an egg. It is easy to break from the inside, yet difficult to shatter from the outside.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well then, until next time...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes.」

name: Misa
message: 「U-Um, well...」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's sit on the bench.」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No. I'm heading home now...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm on a break with time to kill anyway, so I'll walk you part of the way.」

name: Misa
message: 「What's that supposed to mean! Making it sound like I'm just a way to pass the time!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I see. If you want to that badly, Sakura-kun, I suppose I'll let you walk me. Only part of the way, though!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's the Misa I know.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-Idiot...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What!? It's nothing!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm the only one listening, you know.」

name: Misa
message: 「Geez, that's exactly why it's hard to say.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'll walk with you until you make up your mind to talk, Misa. Maybe today I'll finally get to walk you all the way home.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nghh...!」

name: Misa
message: 「...I'll tell you. After all, you're the only one I can talk to about this.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka and I are having a fight...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I know. At yesterday's Student Council meeting--」

name: Misa
message: 「No, you don't! That's part of it, sure, but... it's not just some superficial squabble like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「I get that, too. Whenever the two of you go quiet, the air gets all prickly...」

name: Misa
message: 「It's all my fault... I did something awful to Nanaka...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not just your fault, Misa. I'm the one who pulled the trigger.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, you...」

name: Misa
message: 「...We really are clumsy, aren't we.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Misa
message: 「I regret what I did.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, that alone isn't enough. I have to make up with Nanaka.」

name: Misa
message: 「And yet, I just can't find the right opening...」

name: Misa
message: 「Just as Big Sister and Lolotte-san fear, at this rate even the success of the Holy Night Festival is in jeopardy.」

name: Misa
message: 「I know I'm being selfish... but I want to get back the relationship we used to have.」

name: Synn
message: 「I was thinking the exact same thing as you, Misa.」

name: Synn
message: 「And after having so many of our friends lend me a hand and give me a push forward, I finally remembered.」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't I... didn't all of us want to spend a sparkling, wonderful school life together? ...That's what hit me.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, a sparkling school life... KiraFes... a sparkling Holy Night Festival...」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What! You're the one who realized it first, Sakura-kun, so take responsibility and say it. Even if you hand me the win, I won't be happy at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but you're the one actually taking action, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Right. A Holy Night Festival song that everyone can sing together!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, you're still in the middle of making it, right? Will you make it in time if you change it now.」

name: Misa
message: 「Leave it to me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then we have our answer. Try pouring the feelings you hold into the lyrics, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「And then, sing it to get through to Nanaka-san...」

name: Misa
message: 「Yeah! I'll do it! Coming to you for advice really was the right call!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hah!? D-D-D-Don't get the wrong idea! All you did was give me a clue to solve this!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll settle the rest with my own strength!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm no match for you, you're amazing, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you talking about. You've been beating me all this tiiiime, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I meant, how should I put it...」

name: Synn
message: 「I was thinking about wiping your tears away with a kiss if you cried during your monologue, Misa, but your eyes only welled up a little.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-W-W-W-Wha--!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Owwwww.」
Misa steps on my foot with all her might.

name: Misa
message: 「You really are...!」

name: Misa
message: 「...Hehe, you said that on purpose, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I have no idea.」

name: Misa
message: 「I know, though. That's just the kind of person you are. That's why Nanaka-san also...」

name: Melilot
message: 「D-Did something happen with a kiss!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaa!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san, why are you here?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, I by no means overreacted to the word 'kiss'」

name: Melilot
message: 「Stare--」

name: Misa
message: 「...Hey! Why is Melilot-san following us!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Mumble, mumble... How should I know?」

name: Synn
message: 「We've made it to the school gate, so what do you want to do? The Student Council room is empty today, so we'd have it to ourselves--perfect for writing lyrics.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmm... I want to write the lyrics at home. If we're in my room, we won't have to worry about randomly running into Nanaka-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, it'd be bad if she found out about the lyrics.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Stare--, gawk gawk.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Pay no mind to my licking, heated gaze--now, please kiss to your hearts' content.」

name: Misa
message: 「We will not!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's Helena, who loves French kisses.\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Glug, glug... Phew~, hic.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Helena-san, I think chugging alcohol straight from the bottle outdoors is dangerous...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, ufufufufu, hic. For a homebody like Melilot to come all the way out here must be an emergency.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have my own reasons. Please leave me be, Helena.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm the one who wants to be left alone!」

name: Helena
message: 「Now, now, Misa-chan, calm down, calm down.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's just a drunk...」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot knows all the dirty details in theory. She's still never seen a real-world kiss with her own eyes.」

name: Helena
message: 「So... you know? Ufun.\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「What do you mean, 'right?'?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena, please do not say such vulgar things. Out of academic curiosity, I am merely attempting to observe the phenomenon known as a kiss.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's just a Peeping Tom...」

name: Helena
message: 「In short, you're just driven by the same curiosity as me, aren't you? Hic~」

name: Synn
message: 「The same as me...? Don't tell me even you, Helena-san?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, Misa-chan... For the sake of Melilot's social studies too, how about giving us a big smooch right here.\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「I said no means no!!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... Misa, maybe we should call it a night on seeing them off here?」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No way...! I still have things to talk about.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see.」

name: Synn
message: 「...We're running, Misa, follow me!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「T-They ran away? Why?」

name: Helena
message: 「I won't let you get away~. After them, my minions!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hah, hah, hah...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, are you okay? You look more out of breath than usual...」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up! My limiter only comes off when I'm running away from Sakura-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Can I take your hand? So you don't fall behind, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hah, hah, hah...!」
Misa's hand, clasping mine, begins to grow warm.
I squeeze her hand back firmly.

name: Misa
message: 「Pfft, heehee...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahahahaha!」

name: Misa
message: 「Heeheeheehee!」

name: Misa
message: 「Haa, haa, haa, haaaah--」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't believe it took until evening just to shake them off.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, it's been a while since I had that much fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, laughing from the bottom of your stomach is the best.」
Despite how they look, Helena-san and the others are sharp. No matter how hard I tried, there's no way I could have outrun them.
They must have chased us on purpose, and then let us go.

name: Synn
message: 「Let's laugh together with everyone at the Holy Night Festival too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, definitely.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, do you remember when I said I still had something to talk to you about?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course.」

name: Synn
message: 「Though... we've already reached our usual fork in the road.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. Actually, though, what I was planning to talk about has already been resolved. Thanks to you.」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't do anything, though?」

name: Misa
message: 「You took my hand and led me all the way to the school route.」

name: Misa
message: 「You see... ever since I had that fight with Nanaka-san, I've been avoiding this road on my way to and from school.」

name: Misa
message: 「But I'm okay now. Starting tomorrow, I'll be able to walk it properly on my own.」

name: Synn
message: 「...On your own?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio will be with me sometimes, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Misa
message: 「Just kidding.」

name: Misa
message: 「What I wanted to talk about... is your confession.」

name: Misa
message: 「I still haven't given you my answer, have I? You just went ahead and assumed things on your own and went home, Sakura-kun.」

name: Misa
message: 「It wouldn't be fair if I didn't tell you how I feel before I sing for Nanaka-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「I, Misa B. Cristelis, hereby give my answer to Synn Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Idiot... close your eyes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmf... ah, Sakura-kun...」

name: Misa
message: 「Mwah...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Mm, haah...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, I--」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm sorry. I can't go out with you.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm glad you were my first kiss...」

name: Misa
message: 「I've told so many lies to Nanaka-san, and to my own feelings too.」

name: Misa
message: 「But this much is true...」

name: Misa
message: 「A kiss tastes different from how I imagined...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, at least let me walk you home.」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, of course not. Go back to your Demon Lord training.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Okay, I'm heading off.」

name: Misa
message: 「Take care.」
